Definition: Whether an official government web portal or mobile application exists where taxpayers can file tax returns and pay taxes online with direct e-payment capability linked to instant payment system.
Comments: Zimbabwe has an operational tax portal: ZIMRA provides online portals for registration and return submission including E-Services (efiling.zimra.co.zw) and E-Taxes (etaxes.zimra.co.zw) for submission/viewing returns and compliance status ([ZIMRA E-Taxes online platform](https://www.zimra.co.zw/news/2239:e-taxes-online-platform-2);[ZIMRA e-services facility – online BP registration](https://www.zimra.co.zw/news/22-taxmans-corner/2224-zimra-e-services-facility-online-bp-registration)).

Definition: Whether the instant payment system enables or plans to enable instant payments across national borders to other countries or regional payment systems, supporting remittances, trade, and regional integration.
Comments: Cross-border functionality is not available for ZIPIT currently (case study explicitly notes no cross-border transaction capability), though cross-border is discussed as a future area (e.g., regional integration aspirations) ([AfricaNenda SIIPS 2024 ZIPIT case study](https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/siips_2024_ZIPIT_CaseStudy_en.pdf)).

Definition: Whether the system enables consumer payments to merchants and businesses for goods and services, including retail purchases, bill payments, e-commerce, and subscription services.
Comments: Merchant payments (P2B) are supported via ZIPIT (P2B use case noted) and via EcoCash merchant payments/QR Scan & Pay for merchants ([AfricaNenda SIIPS 2024 ZIPIT case study](https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/siips_2024_ZIPIT_CaseStudy_en.pdf);[EcoCash Merchants](https://ecocash.co.zw/merchants/)).

Definition: Whether and how the central bank participates in payment system governance beyond its regulatory oversight role, including board representation, operational management, technical standard-setting, or direct system operation.
Comments: RBZ has a direct operational role in core payment infrastructure: under the National Payment Systems Act it establishes/operates settlement systems (s7) and provides finality/discharge of settlement obligations (s8) ([National Payment Systems Act – ZimLII](https://zimlii.org/akn/zw/act/2001/21/eng@2016-12-31)). For ZIPIT, RBZ’s RTGS is the settlement rail (deferred net settlement T+1) and RBZ influences governance/operations (appointments, product approvals, pricing), and acquired a 15% stake in Zimswitch in 2020 ([AfricaNenda SIIPS 2024 ZIPIT case study](https://www.africanenda.org/uploads/files/siips_2024_ZIPIT_CaseStudy_en.pdf)).
